name: Diskwala & Terabox Telegram Bot
description: Telegram bot that resolves Diskwala/Terabox share links, shows file info with download buttons, and delivers files into the chat.

TERABOX_COOKIES.description: Terabox account cookie, e.g. ndus=XXXX; lang=en (comma-separate several accounts)

MAX_FILE_MB.description: Max file size (MB) to upload into Telegram. Cloud Bot API limit is 50, so keep 48 on Heroku.
